title: Reduction versus remodeling in pediatric distal forearm fractures: a preliminary cost analysis
design_evidence: retrospectively evaluated 34 pediatric metaphyseal wrist fractures that lost position after attempted reduction and healed in their angulated or shortened position. We then did a comparison cost analysis with time matched patients who had complete but minimally displaced fractures of the distal radius
population: skeletally immature children (age less than 14 years for boys, 12 years for girls) with isolated distal radius or distal both bone forearm fractures
